ports.note: Takes the chosen product and the study area, whose extent is searched. Emits satellite-files: remote files not yet read, its own port type so nothing mistakes addresses for data.

ontology.note: The receipt states the catalog, collection, product, extent, dates, how many items were returned, matched and kept, whether the search stopped at its limit, and fw:completenessRead false: a search reads no pixels. Held by fw:SatelliteCatalogSearchShape.

changes.description: Search the chosen product's STAC collection over the study area's extent and a date range, up to 500 items, catalog records only. Three columns from JLT's STAC Browser (MIT, commit 945d8b3), in Fieldwork's dialog style: Connect & discover, Coverage in context (the study area and each item's footprint), Inspect & reuse (each item's files, with sign-in, licence as read, whether a browser can read it, the attribution sentence, and that completeness and citation are not yet known). Keep or drop items. Experiment 179.

evidence.note: The search builder, its messages and the 500-item bound are JLT's, ported. Unit tests use a stubbed catalog; a live search was run against Planetary Computer in a browser. Nothing here reads a file, so nothing establishes that an item holds usable pixels over the area.
